title: CreateModelDetails
description: The information needed to create a new model.

aliasName.description: the alias name of the model.

componentModels.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) list of active custom Key Value models that need to be composed.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer, and boolean types are supported.

A key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

description.description: An optional description of the model.

displayName.default: The display name of the model.
displayName.description: A human-friendly name for the model, which can be changed.

freeformTags.description:
A simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type, or scope. It exists for cross-compatibility only.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

inferenceUnits.description: Number of replicas required for this model.
inferenceUnits.x-default-description: When unspecified, the number of replicas for the model will be set to 1

isQuickMode.description: Set to true when experimenting with a new model type or dataset, so the model training is quick, with a predefined low number of passes through the training data.

language.description: The document language for model training, abbreviated according to the BCP 47 syntax.
language.x-default-description: when unspecified, the document language will be english

maxTrainingTimeInHours.description: The maximum model training time in hours, expressed as a decimal fraction.

modelType.description: The type of the Document model.

modelVersion.x-default-description: If not provided, a default one will be generated by the service.

projectId.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the project that contains the model.

ComponentModel.description: The custom model selected for Composition.

modelId.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of active custom Key Value model that need to be composed.

Dataset.description: The base entity which is the input for creating and training a model.

datasetType.description: The dataset type, based on where it is stored.

ModelSubType.description: Sub type model based on the model type.

modelType.description:
Sub type model based on the model type.
The allowed values are:
- `PRE_TRAINED_KEY_VALUE_EXTRACTION`
- `PRE_TRAINED_DOCUMENT_ELEMENTS_EXTRACTION`
